summary: Re-confirmed live (2026-07-26) that the dome-site WIN-062 duplicate-heading state (id=win-062 / id=win-062-constant, same data-claim-key, no WIN-062B split) is unchanged from the 2026-07-10 original finding (ISS-2961) and the 2026-07-25 re-flag (ISS-3013).
